MINUTES
  PLANNING COMMISSION MEETING
  OCTOBER 1, 2018

  A regular meeting of the Planning Commission of the City of Rolling Hills Estates was called to
  order at 7:00 p.m. in the City Hall Council Chamber, 4045 Palos Verdes Drive North, by CHAIR
  MEDAWAR.
  2.  PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE
  COMMISSIONER SCOTT led those in attendance in the Pledge of Allegiance
  3.  ROLL CALL
  COMMISSIONERS PRESENT:  Edler, Scott, Medawar, Zigrang, Schachter, Yoo
  COMMISSIONERS ABSENT:  Carman
  STAFF PRESENT:  Planning Director Wahba, Associate Planner Thom,
  Administrative Assistant Corea
  4.  APPROVAL OF MINUTES
  COMMISSIONER SCHACHTER made a motion, seconded by COMMISSIONER
  SCOTT to,
  APPROVE THE CORRECTED MINUTES OF THE PLANNING COMMISSION
  MEETING OF SEPTEMBER 10, 2018.
  There being no objection, CHAIR MEDAWAR so ordered.
  5.  AUDIENCE ITEMS
  None
  6.  CONSENT CALENDAR
  A.  WAIVE READING IN FULL OF ALL RESOLUTIONS THAT ARE PRESENTED FOR THE
  CONSIDERATION OF THE PLANNING COMMISSION ON TONIGHT’S AGENDA AND
  ALL SUCH RESOLUTIONS SHALL BE READ BY TITLE ONLY.
  COMMISSIONER SCOTT made a motion, seconded by COMMISSIONER YOO to,
  APPROVE ITEM 6-A
  There being no objection, CHAIR MEDAWAR so ordered.
  7.  BUSINESS ITEMS
  A.  PLANNING APPLICATION NO. 16-18; APPLICANT: MR. GEORGE SHEN; LOCATION:
  4 SINGLETREE LANE; A request for a Neighborhood Compatibility Determination to
  demolish the existing one-story home and to construct a new one-story home. A Grading
  Application is required for grading in the rear yard.

  Associate Planner Thom presented Planning Application No. 16-18 and provided a
  PowerPoint presentation with an overview of the proposed project.
  Staff recommends that the Planning Commission approve PA-16-18 with the conditions
  that, 1) the new garage be equipped with an electrical vehicle charging stations; 2) the
  applicant submit a final landscape plan; 3) that all construction be in conformance with the
  approved plans; and 4) that the applicant obtain building permits within two years of
  approval of this application.
  COMMISSIONER EDLER asked if Singletree is a private street owned by the
  homeowners and asked if there is an HOA. Planning Director Wahba stated that there is
  no HOA and the street is owned by property owners.
  COMMISSIONER ZIGRANG asked about requirements for construction fencing.
  Planning Director Wahba stated that for private streets there are no written rules, however
  the fencing should be behind the Peppertrees so vehicles can maneuver into the soft
  shoulder or 8-10 feet back from the edge of the street. Planning Director Wahba stated
  that as a condition for approval, all construction parking should be required to be off-street.
  In another similar scenario, photos were taken before construction and after construction
  and were reviewed in order to determine the extent of damage to the street.

Planning Commission Meeting Minutes,  1
October 1, 2018
   COMMISSIONER SCHACHTER asked about how streets are assessed for repairs.
  Planning Director Wahba stated that neighbors will meet when street repair issues arise
  in front of a particular home.
  COMMISSIONER SCOTT suggested that the construction fence should be set back 20
  feet. He also suggested that material deliveries be limited to certain hours to reduce
  interruption in flow of traffic during busier hours. COMMISSIONER ZIGRANG stated that
  there may be issues coordinating hours, and stated that backing up into a deep driveway
  with a double fence gate should work for material deliveries.
  COMMISSIONER SCOTT stated that vendors should be encouraged to deliver at limited
  times of the day. He suggested including as a condition of approval assessment of the
  street before and after and that it be mitigated prior to the issuance of the Certificate of
  Occupancy.
  Tim Buresh, 5 Singletree Lane, stated that there is plenty of room to have vehicles parked
  on-site and there is also parking along Rolling Hills Road and there is a large set-back
  between there and the Botanical Garden. He also stated that he would appreciate adding
  the paving restriction and stated that concern is mostly with the large trailers. Mr. Buresh
  stated that there is an 800 sq. ft. barn and asked if it will be a barn or ADU. Planning
  Director Wahba stated that there is not a proposal for an ADU at this time.
  COMMISSIONER SCOTT stated that this is a horse overlay zone and is required to
  have a horsekeeping area.
  COMMISSIONER SCHACHTER asked how street maintenance is paid for. Mr. Buresh
  stated that no one has.
  COMMISSIONER SCHACHTER asked the last time it was repaired. Mr. Buresh stated
  that it is more than 20 years ago.
  Mr. Buresh stated that the bulk of the impact will be at the front of the construction site.
  CHAIR MEDAWAR asked about traffic. Mr. Buresh stated that it is in waves due to
  school schedules and some traffic is due to package deliveries.
  COMMISSIONER YOO asked if there is a plan to repave the road. Mr. Buresh stated
  that not at this time.
  In response to a question by COMMISSIONER SCOTT, Mr. Buresh stated that he has no
  issue with the design of the project.
  CHAIR MEDAWAR asked about the time of the notices. Planning Director Wahba stated
  that staff can work on mailing them out earlier, but that they were mailed out 10 days
  prior as required.
  Mr. George Shen, Property Owner/Applicant, stated that his driveway is quite wide
  and could accommodate four vehicles and hopes that the narrow road is not
  used for construction parking. Mr. Shen stated that he road has been in disrepair for
  many years and hopes that he and the neighbors can get together for a common effort
  to pave a new road.
  COMMISSIONER SCOTT asked about the setback on the eastern side of the property.
  Associate Planner Thom stated that it is 12 feet. COMMISSIONER SCOTT stated that
  there is not enough access to and from a horse keeping area. Planning Director Wahba
  stated that for the future, it can be widened by moving the retaining wall closer to the
  property line.
  COMMISSIONER SCOTT made a motion, seconded by COMMISSIONER ZIGRANG to,
  APPROVE STAFF’S RECOMMENDATION TO APPROVE PLANNING APPLICATION
  NO. 16-18 WITH THE ADDITIONAL CONDITIONS FROM STAFF, WHICH INCLUDE: 1)
  THAT THE NEW GARAGE BE EQUIPPED WITH AN ELECTRICAL VEHICLE
  CHARGING STATIONS; 2) THAT THE APPLICANT SUBMIT A FINAL LANDSCAPE
  PLAN FOR COMPLIANCE TO THE CITY’S WATER EFFICIENCY ORDINANCE; 3)
  THAT ALL CONSTRUCTION BE IN CONFORMANCE WITH THE APPROVED PLANS.
  ANY ALTERATIONS OR ADDTIONS TO THE APPROVED PLAN, INCLUDING
  ADDITIONAL DEMOLITION, OR ANY CHANGES TO THE EXTERIOR TREATMENT
  INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO EXTERIOR BUILDING MATERIALS OR THE SIZE,
  SHAPE, OR LOCATION OF WINDOWS OR OTHER OPENING, OR CHANGES TO THE
  SIZE, LOCATION OR AMOUNT OF ANY HARDSCAPE SHALL BE REVIEWED BY THE
  PLANNING DIRECTOR TO DETERMINE IF FURTHER PLANNING COMMISSION
  APPROVAL IS NECESSARY; AND 4) THAT THE APPLICANT OBTAIN BUILDING
  PERMITS WITHIN TWO YEARS OF APPROVAL OF THIS APPLICATION. IN
Planning Commission Meeting Minutes,  2
October 1, 2018
   ADDITION, THAT THE APPROVAL IS SUBJECT TO BEFORE AND AFTER OF
  PAVEMENT QUALITY IN FRONT OF THE PROPERTY AND MAINTAINING THE
  CONSTRUCTION FENCES AT LEAST 20 FEET BACK FROM THE PAVEMENT AND
  THAT ALL CONSTRUCTION VEHICLES PARK OFF THE PAVEMENT.
  AYES:  EDLER, SCOTT, MEDAWAR, ZIGRANG, SCHACHTER, YOO
  NOES:
  ABSENT:  CARMAN
  ABSTAIN:

  Planning Director Wahba stated that there is a 20-day appeal period for this item.

  8.  PUBLIC HEARINGS
  A.  PLANNING APPLICATION NO. 14-18; APPLICANT: MR. STEVE LOO; LOCATION: 9
  LANTANA PLACE; A request for a Neighborhood Compatibility Determination for the
  construction of one-story additions to both the home and existing two-car garage. A
  Variance is requested to decrease the side yard by more than 10%. A second Variance
  is requested to decrease the front yard by more than 10%.
  COMMISSIONER SCOTT stated that he will recuse himself due to living within 500 feet
  of the subject property.
  Associate Planner Thom presented Planning Application No. 14-18 and provided a
  PowerPoint presentation with an overview on this project and added that copies of a letter
  received today from an adjacent neighbor has been provided to the Planning
  Commissioners.
  Associate Planner Thom stated that staff recommends that the Planning Commission:
  open the public hearing; take public testimony; discuss the issues; close the public
  hearing; and adopt resolution no. PA-14-18 approving the project.
  CHAIR MEDAWAR opened the public hearing.
  Edward Mohr, 11 Lantana Place, expressed his concern with mutual privacy issues. Mr.
  Mohr stated that he could walk out onto his deck and he will be able to see into their living
  room. Mr. Mohr referred to the driveway plan and addressed potential problems with the
  sewer lines and retaining walls. Mr. Mohr suggested a separate condition be added to
  install a retaining wall to maintain the slope with 11 Lantana Place. Mr. Mohr did question
  the driveway and stated that moving it forward 13 feet may be problematic. Mr. Mohr
  stated that he is pleased with the design and communication on this project.
  CHAIR MEDAWAR asked if he is positive about the location of the sewer line. Mr. Mohr
  stated that he is more than 90% positive that it runs through the embankment.
  COMMISSIONER ZIGRANG asked how deep the sewer is. Mr. Mohr stated that it is
  approximately 12 feet deep.
  Robert Breshears, 7 Lantana, stated that the property has been in disrepair for the past
  20 years and the fence is falling into his yard. Mr. Breshears stated that he has no issue
  with the design and just wants this project to begin.
  Planning Director Wahba stated that this has been an existing code enforcement case for
  some years and in the interim the home was supposed to be painted and the fence
  repaired. He has discussed with the architect the urgency in presenting these plans to the
  Planning Commission for review.
  Dustin Greg, Architect, stated that if the sewer line is found during construction they will
  fix it or reroute it. Planning Director Wahba stated that it is a private sewer line and when
  it was installed, sometimes they were not respective of property lines.
  COMMISSIONER ZIGRANG asked if an engineer will engineer the footings for the
  retaining wall. Mr. Greg stated that they will engineer it to support it.
  COMMISSIONER ZIGRANG asked about the gable roof above the garage. Mr. Greg
  stated that it will be a gable roof.
  COMMISSIONER SCHACHTER thanked the architect and neighbors for working
  together.
  Tim Scott, NEIGHBOR, stated that this house is in disrepair but looks better now than
  before and stated that the variances are not an issue since they have deep lot with a lot
  of hill that is unbuildable.

Planning Commission Meeting Minutes,  3
October 1, 2018
   COMMISSIONER YOO made a motion, seconded by COMMISSIONER SCHACHTER to,
  CLOSE THE PUBLIC HEARING
  There being no objection, CHAIR MEDAWAR so ordered.
  COMMISSIONER EDLER made a motion, seconded by COMMISSIONER SCHACHTER
  to,
  APPROVE PLANNING APPLICATION NO. PA-14-18, WITH AN ADDITIONAL
  CONDITION OF ADDING AN ENGINEERED RETAINING WALL ALONG THE
  SIDE AND ALONG THE DRIVEWAY AND THE RETAINING WALL IN THE
  FRONT YARD NOT EXCEED 2 FEET AND MAY BE BUILT HIGHER TOWARD
  THE REAR.
  AYES:  EDLER, MEDAWAR, ZIGRANG, SCHACHTER, YOO
  NOES:
  ABSENT:  CARMAN
  ABSTAIN:  SCOTT

  Planning Director Wahba stated that there is a 20-day appeal period for this item.

  9.  COMMISSION ITEMS

  None
  10.  DIRECTOR ITEMS
  Planning Director Wahba stated that the joint meeting which was schedule for October 9,
  2018 has been cancelled.
  11.  MATTERS OF INFORMATION
  A.  CITY COUNCIL ACTIONS, SEPTEMBER 25, 2018
  B.  DRAFT MINUTES OF THE PARK AND ACTIVITIES COMMISSION, SEPTEMBER 17,
  2018
  COMMISSIONER SCOTT made a motion to,
  RECEIVE AND FILE ITEMS 11-A and 11-B
  There being no objection, CHAIR MEDAWAR so ordered
  12.  ADJOURNMENT
  CHAIR MEDAWAR adjourned the meeting at 8:05 p.m. The next Planning Commission
  meeting will be held on Monday, November 5, 2018 at 7:00 p.m.

  Respectfully submitted,  Approved,

  ____________________________  ________________________
  Carol Corea  Heidi Luce
  Administrative Assistant  City Clerk

Planning Commission Meeting Minutes,  4
October 1, 2018
